query:
UPDATE collector
               SET last_seen_at = now(),
                   hostname   = COALESCE($2, hostname),
                   version    = COALESCE($3, version),
                   reported   = COALESCE($4, reported),
                   started_at = COALESCE($5, started_at),
                   received   = $6,
                   written    = $7,
                   lost       = $8
             WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING id
